block_dataset: block a dataset by creating a dataset blockage entry in the MongoDB database
get_blocked_datasets: get the list of all blocked dataset names from the MongoDB database
is_blocked: check whether a specific dataset is currently blocked in the MongoDB database
test_dataset_blockage: test the dataset blockage functions with multiple dataset inputs and expected results
DatasetBlockageDocument: use the DatasetBlockageDocument model to store and query dataset blockage records in MongoDB
